description: Wire optional wgpu 29.0.3 GPU compute into outram-mc-libs for an embarrassingly-parallel MC kernel. Target-gated dep (desktop present / Android absent). gpu module #[cfg(not(target_os=android))] with probe()->Option<GpuContext>; Android CPU-only shim. Kernel: batched pointwise cross-section interpolation on a shared energy grid (grid search + linear interp), porting OpenMC src/nuclide.cpp Nuclide::calculate_xs (i_grid bracket + interp_factor f, sigma=(1-f)*xs[i]+f*xs[i+1]). CPU f64 is the trusted/deterministic reference; GPU f32 is acceleration only. GPU test asserts GPU~=CPU within tol IF probe() gives a device, else SKIP. android cargo check clean. AI draft under docs/ai-fleet-review/outram-mc-wgpu/.
title: outram-mc-libs: optional wgpu GPU compute (target-gated, CPU fallback) -- batched pointwise XS interpolation kernel
